referencias.legenda_completa: You tap a card. Where did the page go? A hard cut makes people find their place again. Motion carries them instead: the card becomes the page, and back goes back. Nothing just appears. Everything came from somewhere. Send this to your designer. #theglidestudio #webdesign #uxdesign #uiux #motiondesign
referencias.o_que_mostra: "Tap. Cut." vs "Don't cut. Carry.": card vira a página, back volta, menu nasce do botão (demo em site de loja)
referencias.transcricao: You tap. Where did the page go? A hard cut makes people find their place again. Motion can carry them instead. Watch the same tap. The card you touched grows into the page itself. Go back, and it shrinks to exactly where it came from. Menus too. They come from the button that opened them. Nobody gets lost because nothing just appears. Everything on screen came from somewhere. Send this to your designer.
